errors.evidence: The description misinterprets the x-axis bins of the histogram as discrete labels and provides inaccurate estimates for their positions. The bars represent ranges (e.g., 0.0-0.2, 0.2-0.4), not single points. Furthermore, the estimated points are mostly incorrect: the first bar is centered at 0.1 (not 0.05), the third at 0.5 (not 0.45), the fourth at 0.7 (not 0.65), and the fifth at 0.9 (not 0.95).
